import json,sys,hashlib
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
sys.path.insert(0,str(Path('scripts/studies').resolve()))
from fluxbridge_shared_jk_gradient_study import independent
p=Path('/tmp/fluxbridge-layout-20261026');r=json.loads((p/'gradient-reference.json').read_text())
for c in r['rows']:
 if c['convergence']<=1e-12:continue
 old=(np.asarray(c['lean']),np.asarray(c['basis']))
 for order in (128,160,192,224):
  if order<=c['orders'][-1]:continue
  new=independent(c,order);err=max(float(np.max(abs(old[i]-new[i])/(1+abs(new[i])))) for i in (0,1))
  c.update(lean=new[0].tolist(),basis=new[1].tolist(),convergence=err);c['orders'].append(order);old=new
  if err<=1e-12:break
 print(c['label'],c['orders'],c['convergence'],flush=True)
r['worst_convergence']=max(c['convergence'] for c in r['rows']);r['reference_target']=1e-12
r['refinement_source_sha256']=hashlib.sha256(Path(__file__).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
(p/'gradient-reference-tight.json').write_text(json.dumps(r,indent=2)+'\n')
assert r['worst_convergence']<=1e-12,r['worst_convergence']

interpretation: Packed/reloaded scalar state is 112 registers versus 128 early-contraction and 134 original; runtime remains near fp64 compute limit
Occupancy-only is 94 registers; streamed P1 values stay 120 registers at 1/3/12/28 components
Lean lambda/G/Cov and streamed P1 gradient fields use 136 registers independent of component count; single-field early-gradient uses 132
All final profiled variants have zero local load/store sectors; runtime kernel properties report zero local allocation
28 P1 field components are not the full 28 distinct monomial/gradient/Hessian operators
Vertex reload lowers register state but increases arithmetic/load work slightly; cached layouts remain available and can be faster
Shared-vs-repeated comparison uses identical nodal/query/output buffers, includes mixed geometry and CUDA graph timing
The new exact-edge-line tangential-potential limit is necessary for Cov; the old occupancy-only skip remains valid for that older operator
No production dispatch, 2D backend, pressure/porosity solver or raw-fp32 acceptance was changed
limitations: Experimental device functions and measurement drivers, not production replacements
Validation uses finite 1e-10 fp64 budgets and independently converged CPU references, not universal error bounds
FLOPs count add/mul/FMA (FMA=2); divisions, roots, transcendental and control/integer costs are not assigned equivalent FLOPs
Canonical NCU counts are workload specific; mixed performance is measured for P1 value contractions, not the new gradient family
Geometry setup remains a host-fp64 loop; static preparation and JIT are excluded from warm/transfer timings
Gradient transfer timer includes allocation/upload/kernel/readback; it is not the full native search/assembly/application path
Large output readback remains expensive; 84 gradient outputs/pair are 672 MiB at 1048576 pairs
GPU measurements serialized, clocks/caches/desktop activity uncontrolled; no locked-clock claim or strict minor speedup claim
A 1024-byte profiler stack reservation is separate from the measured zero local allocation/traffic
